_comment: Reviewed reclassifications layered over the RadioReference scrape in lwin_talkgroups.json, which is upstream and is never edited. RadioReference's enc describes how a talkgroup is documented, not what it transmits. Produced by: python3 scripts/enc_harvest.py --report. Each entry records why it was accepted and when, so a decision can be revisited against the evidence that produced it.

_example.why: 21 of 21 calls intelligible; no ESS ever observed
